newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-MILAN SNATCH LATE VICTORY OVER OLYMPIAKOS.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-MILAN SNATCH LATE VICTORY OVER OLYMPIAKOS.

text.p: Stefanel Milan held on to top position in their EuroLeague basketball group on Thursday, beating Olympiakos of Greece 73-71.
Milan's Flavio Portaluppi scored a basket in the final seconds to secure the victory in a hard-fought and evenly-matched game. Just 40 seconds from the end, the teams had been tied 70-70.
After holding only a one-point lead at halftime (39-38), the Italians gained their largest advantage, nine points, halfway into the second half.
Olympiakos, led by Panyaniotis Fassoulas and David Rivers who both scored 15 points, rallied but were unable to avoid a sixth defeat from 12 European matches this season.
Warren Kidd led Milan's scorers with 20 points.
Milan, with a 9-3 record, look all set for the round of the last 16, but Olympiakos, after a disappointing campaign, face a stiff task.

Alba Berlin, the surprise team of the season, boosted their chances with an excellent 69-67 victory away to CSKA Moscow. With an 8-4 record, they are second in group E to Milan and should also make the knock-out stage, starting in March.
Other sides well placed with four more games left in the group phase include champions Panathinaikos (9-3) and Villeurbanne of France (also 9-3).
Efes Pilsen of Turkey (10-2) are already through to the last 16 after beating Split 74-64 on Wednesday as are Teamsystem Bologna (9-3), easy 90-76 winners on Thursday over ex-champions Limoges.
Meanwhile, big-name Barcelona slipped to 5-7 on Wednesday, losing 91-87 away to Partizan Belgrade and also face a battle to make the last 16.
